site.title: {project} - Partaz fisye desantralize
site.description: {project} se enn program peer-to-peer pou partaze fisye, baze lor teknolozi modern desantralize.
site.ogDescription: Partaz fisye peer-to-peer baze lor teknolozi modern desantralize. Pena okenn server santral. Pena okenn sel pwen failure.

hero.subtitle: Partaz fisye peer-to-peer prosenn zenerasyon
hero.description: Baze lor teknolozi modern desantralize. Pena okenn server santral. Pena okenn sel pwen failure.

about.title: Lor
about.intro: {project} se enn platform prosenn zenerasyon pou partaz fisye peer-to-peer, baze lor teknolozi modern desantralize. Li konbinn enn entrfas fasil pou servi avek enn larsitektir konpletman desantralize, garanti enn partaz fisye sekirize ek fyab san bizin enn lotorite santral. Sa proze la se open source, larg anba {license}.

decentralized.title: Rezo konpletman desantralize
decentralized.description: Pena okenn server santral, pena okenn sel pwen failure. Bann itilizater trouv ek telesarz konteni direkteman ar lezot, san depan lor okenn lindeks santral, motor resers ouswa baz done.

accessControl.title: Kontrol fin lor lakse
accessControl.description: Ninport ki kapav konstri so prop rezo avek so prop bann regleman, gratis. Dan sak rezo, bann rol itilizater inn defini: proprieter, administrater, editer, moderater, ek swiver. Ou ena enn kontrol fin lor kisannla kapav pibliye, modere, ek telesarz konteni.

ui.title: Entrfas o kalite
ui.description: Enn entrfas media center prop ek rapid, dizay pou desktop, TV, ek bann platform mobil. Navigasyon fasil avek klavye, lasouri, gamepad, ouswa telekomann. Bann itilizater eksperimante kapav fer program la roule kouma server san latet atraver lentrfas linn komand.

dataFormat.title: Format done lizib pou imen
dataFormat.description: Format done LISH baze lor JSON, ki rann li fasil pou kreye, lir, ek konpran. Partaz ou konteni avek metadata kler ek transparan, ki ninport ki kapav verifie.

security.title: Lavi prive ek sekirite
security.description: Tou bann kominikasyon peer-to-peer inn kripte, garanti ki ou done res prive dan transi. Bann itilizater kapav kasyet deryer enn VPN pou plis lanonima. {project} respekte ou lavi prive par dizay.

crossPlatform.title: Miltiplatform
crossPlatform.description: Program la disponib pou Windows, Linux, ek macOS. Servi li lor platform ki ou prefere.

download.title: Telesarze
download.description: Pran {project} pou ou platform. Tou telesarzman gratis ek open source.

macos.title: Avi inportan pou bann itilizater macOS:
macos.intro: macOS Gatekeeper pou blok bann aplikasyon ki pa siyne/pa notarize ki finn telesarze depi Internet avek enn erer {error}.
macos.runCommand: Apre ou finn telesarz DMG ouswa ZIP, avan ou ouver aplikasyon la, fer roule sa komand la dan terminal:
macos.exampleDmg: Par egzanp, apre instalasyon depi enn DMG:
macos.explanation: Sa pou tir latribi karantenn ek pou les aplikasyon roule.
